title: CLAUDE.md
text: irxforge R package generating, parsing, converting pharmacometric datasets. handles: - Reformatting clinical trial data analysis formats (NCA ↔︎ NONMEM/modeling, SDTM → NONMEM) - Sampling covariates population PK simulations multiple sources (multivariate normal, bootstrap, MICE imputation, NHANES)

title: CLAUDE.md
text: reformat_data() main dispatcher — auto-detects input format routes specialized functions: - reformat_data_nca_to_modeling() — NCA-ready → NONMEM (separates dose events EVID=1 observations EVID=0) - reformat_data_modeling_to_modeling() — validation/cleanup NONMEM datasets (uppercase columns, MDV column) - reformat_data_sdtm_to_modeling() — SDTM domains (ADSL, DM, EX, PC, VS, LB) → NONMEM using admiral package; derives clinical covariates (BMI, BSA, CrCl, eGFR) - reformat_data_modeling_to_nca() — stub, yet implemented

title: CLAUDE.md
text: sample_covariates() dispatches method argument : - sample_covariates_mvtnorm() — fits multivariate normal observed data, samples - sample_covariates_bootstrap() — nonparametric resampling replacement - sample_covariates_mice() — multiple imputation via chained equations (predictive mean matching) - sample_covariates_nhanes() — downloads/caches NHANES survey data; supports probability-proportional sampling via survey weights (WTMEC2YR)

title: CLAUDE.md
text: .onLoad() hook auto-downloads NHANES 2017–2018 data nhanes_cache/ first package load. download_nhanes_cache() supports years 1999–2020. Cache files per-year RDS files merging DEMO, LAB, EXAM, Q tables.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Dictionary-based column mapping: reformatting sampling functions accept dictionary argument (list(subject_id = "ID", dose = "AMT", ...)) map expected column names actual dataset column names. Conditional filtering: Sampling functions accept conditional = list(AGE = c(18, 65), WT = c(50, 100)) restrict sampling specific covariate ranges. Seed argument: sampling functions accept seed reproducibility, passed dispatcher. na.rm argument: Bootstrap NHANES functions drop NA rows sampling (default TRUE).

title: Reformat data between various data set layouts — reformat_data
text: data data set list data sets. dictionary data dictionary maps expected variable names variables data. input_type type input data set, defined follows: "nca": data set one row every observed concentration measurement. Time, concentration value, administered dose required columns. data set may contain variables, covariates, groupings etc columns. "modeling": data set dose events (evid = 1), concentrations (evid = 0), potentially events (events = 2) separate rows. Dataset requires columns event type, time, dose amount, measured concentration. dataset may contain variables, covariates, groupings etc columns. "sdtm": list various data sets "domains", ADSL DM, EX, DS,  following SDTM structure nomenclature. output_type type output dataset. Can either "nca" "modeling". ... passed onto specific reformatting functions: input_type = "nca" output_type = "modeling": reformat_data_nca_to_modeling() input_type = "sdtm" output_type = "modeling": reformat_data_sdtm_to_modeling() input_type = "modeling" output_type = "modeling": reformat_data_modeling_to_modeling() input_type = "modeling" output_type = "nca": reformat_data_modeling_to_nca()

title: Sample covariates from the NHANES database — sample_covariates_nhanes
text: covariates character vector NHANES variable names include output, e.g. c("RIDAGEYR", "BMXBMI", "WTMEC2YR"). NULL (default), variables cached data returned (SEQN always dropped). year NHANES survey cycle, e.g. "2017-2018". Supported values: "1999-2000", "2001-2002", "2003-2004", "2005-2006", "2007-2008", "2009-2010", "2011-2012", "2013-2014", "2015-2016", "2017-2018", "2019-2020". n_subjects number subjects sample. Default 100. conditional list conditional limits sampled population, e.g. list("RIDAGEYR" = c(18, 65), "BMXBMI" = c(18, 35)). Filters applied sampling. use_weights logical. TRUE, use NHANES 2-year MEC examination weights (WTMEC2YR) probability-proportional sampling, produces sample representative U.S. civilian non-institutionalized population. Requires WTMEC2YR present cached data (included "DEMO" downloaded). Default TRUE. seed integer random seed passed set.seed() reproducibility. Default NULL set seed. dictionary named list mapping user-defined covariate names NHANES variable names, e.g. list("WT" = "BMXWT", "HT" = "BMXHT", "AGE" = "RIDAGEYR"). Names covariates conditional appear keys dictionary translated corresponding NHANES names lookup translated back output. Names present dictionary treated direct NHANES variable names. na.rm logical. TRUE (default), rows NA requested covariates dropped sampling. cache_dir path directory containing merged NHANES RDS file created download_nhanes_cache(). Defaults package-level cache populated automatically first load. Set NULL always download demand via nhanesA (requires internet). ... additional arguments (currently unused)

title: Sample covariates from the NHANES database — sample_covariates_nhanes
text: first load, irxforge automatically downloads NHANES Demographics, Laboratory, Examination tables (cycle 2017-2018) saves single merged RDS file package installation directory. Subsequent calls read cache internet access required. Call download_nhanes_cache() pre-download additional years groups. cache file requested year absent, error raised instructions run download_nhanes_cache(). NHANES uses complex multi-stage sampling design. Survey weights reflect probability selection non-response. Use use_weights = TRUE account sampling.

what: Key covariates in the default cache (NHANES 2017-2018)
title: Sample covariates from the NHANES database — sample_covariates_nhanes
text: default cache merges Demographics, Laboratory, Examination tables. full merged dataset contains variables every table groups; commonly used ones listed . Measurement variables — administrative comment-code fields SI-unit duplicates omitted brevity. Demographics (DEMO_J) Body Measures (BMX_J) Blood Pressure & Pulse (BPX_J) Glycohemoglobin (GHB_J) Standard Biochemistry Profile (BIOPRO_J) Complete Blood Count (CBC_J) Lipids Urine Albumin & Creatinine (ALB_CR_J) full merged dataset contains additional variables Laboratory Examination tables downloaded requested year. Use names(readRDS(file.path(cache_dir, "nhanes_<year>.rds"))) inspect available columns.
